environment: Isolated Chrome browser context with synthetic IndexedDB; real React components, navigation and history database. Context preparation and answer transport mocked only in this context.

checks.name: Opening assistant starts blank even when an older conversation was selected before reload
Explicitly resumed conversation is saved on Back; reopening starts a separate blank chat
Browser back archives current chat; browser forward opens a fresh chat
Reload starts a fresh chat and preserves the complete old conversation
Exiting before conversation creation returns still preserves the first submitted question atomically
Question is persisted before generation; leaving cancels request and late answer cannot enter the next chat
Unfinished saved question is restored into composer and retry completes it without duplicating user turns
Reload during generation preserves the submitted question and returns to a fresh chat
Page-hide lifecycle event archives current chat and reopening starts blank

limitations: Mocked context preparation and answer transport verify lifecycle isolation, not live model or research correctness.
Native Android hardware back and background event delivery are not exercised by this browser test.
Synthetic data is isolated from the user app and actual device data.
